animations.strategy: CSS-only via Tailwind and custom keyframes (no framer-motion). Heavy use of `group-hover` and `animate-*`.

image_urls.description: Abstract high-tech network line background. Use with absolute positioning, -z-10, and an extremely high-opacity white overlay (e.g., bg-white/95 or bg-gradient-to-b from-white/90 to-white) so it creates just a very subtle tech texture without competing with text.
Clean modern medical examination room. Use behind the 'Pain Points' section with a dark overlay (bg-slate-900/90) to contrast with the crisp white cards.

blueprint./app/frontend/src/modules/landing/v2/Lan: Main orchestrator file. Replaces the old LandingPage entirely. Manages state for the DemoModal and is mobile-first responsive.
blueprint./app/frontend/src/modules/landing/v2/com: Sticky navbar (z-50) with glassmorphism. 'Book Free Demo' CTA, smooth scrolling anchor links.
Left: Security-first headline, CTAs. Right: Stylized SVG Dashboard Mockup with lock/shield animations floating on top.
3 premium cards (Key, Zero-Knowledge, Encrypted) using icons.
Contrasting 'Unsafe Systems' vs 'Modern Encrypted'. Darker background or soft gray.
10-card bento grid highlighting security features. Hover-lift effects.
10-card grid showing product features. Clean, functional icons.
4-step visual flow showing the encryption key process.
3-tier pricing (Starter 4,999/yr, Growth 9,999/yr, Enterprise 15,999/yr). Growth highlighted. CTAs trigger demo modal.
Deep blue background (#0B5FFF). Large bold text. Final push to book demo.
Fixed overlay (z-[100]). Form captures email, clinic_name, city, whatsapp, notes. Posts to `/api/public/waitlist-signup` with `source='landing_demo_request'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: COMPLETELY REPLACE `/app/frontend/src/modules/landing/LandingPage.js` with the new design. You can structure it in a `v2` folder or overwrite the existing file.
Do NOT use framer-motion. Rely strictly on Tailwind CSS classes (`group-hover`, `animate-*`, `transition-all`).
For the Hero Section, manually construct a premium SVG graphic mimicking a modern SaaS dashboard UI. Add a prominent lock/shield overlay indicating encryption.
Implement the Demo Modal form using native React state. Show inline success/error messages after `fetch()` to `/api/public/waitlist-signup`.
Ensure the Pricing section explicitly shows the prices requested: Starter (4,999/yr), Growth (9,999/yr), Enterprise (15,999/yr).
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (CTAs, form inputs, toggles).
Do not include the Social Proof/Testimonials section (user instructed to HIDE entirely).
Keep the login page reference in the navbar ('Open Dashboard' if logged in, else 'Login' / 'Book Demo').
Use Lucide-React icons extensively across feature and security grids.
For the 10-card grids (Security Showcase, Features), use a Bento-style layout (mix of col-span-1, col-span-2) to break visual monotony.
